name: Company-ai002_approved_cash_accounts
label: AI002 Approved Cash Account Scope
description: JSON list of approved leaf Cash/Bank account names used as the AI002 available-cash scope (e.g. ["Cash - A2F"]). Empty or invalid means the AI002 forecast is blocked (NEEDS_REVIEW). Managed by finance administrators through the Company form; every change is recorded in the Company document audit fields.
